{{Top|leg}}
'''Corporate Sector Standard''', also known as '''Corpstan''', was a type of communication system used by [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were equipped with software that allowed them to communicate with computers that used Corporate Sector Standard.<ref name="TRG1-">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
